svg.title: Boole, Bonsai, and Qwen3 at 1.7B
svg.desc: The blog's four-model comparison of intelligence density, ten-task benchmark average, and stored weight size. Company logos are embedded; no external assets are required.

svg.title: Intelligence density
svg.desc: Boole-1.7B: 2.803 intelligence density per GB; 247.0 MB stored weights. Bonsai-1.7B: 2.177 intelligence density per GB; 242.4 MB stored weights. Ternary-Bonsai-1.7B: 1.449 intelligence density per GB; 457.3 MB stored weights. Qwen3-1.7B: 0.254 intelligence density per GB; 3,441.1 MB stored weights. Bars start at zero. Preliminary results from our evaluation.

svg.title: Benchmark average
svg.desc: Boole-1.7B: 49.96 ten-task average percent; 247.0 MB stored weights. Bonsai-1.7B: 41.00 ten-task average percent; 242.4 MB stored weights. Ternary-Bonsai-1.7B: 48.46 ten-task average percent; 457.3 MB stored weights. Qwen3-1.7B: 58.34 ten-task average percent; 3,441.1 MB stored weights. Bars start at zero. Preliminary results from our evaluation.

g.text: Ten-task averages; weight storage includes scales. Density = −ln(1 − average/100) / storage_GB (PrismML).
